# Introduction

Boxplots showing total cavity volume (CAVTOT) and total lesion glycolysis (TLG) 
across treatment visits (W0, W4, W16, W24), colour coded by treatment outcome. 
Statistical test: pairwise Wilcoxon tests with FDR corrections.

# Load packages

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(writexl)
```

# Define file paths

```{r}
#| label: file-paths

input_pet   <- "Input/PET.CT_long_SATVI.xlsx"
output_main <- "Output/04. Figure_4A"

dir.create(output_main, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Load data

```{r}
#| label: load-data

pet_data <- read_excel(input_pet, sheet = 1) %>%
  select(ID1, Visit, Comments, CAVTOT, TLG) %>%
  mutate(
    CAVTOT = log10(1 + CAVTOT),
    TLG    = log10(1 + TLG)
  )

head(pet_data)
dim(pet_data)
```

# Curate data

```{r}
#| label: curate-data
plot_data <- pet_data %>%
  mutate(
    Visit    = factor(Visit, levels = c(0, 4, 16, 24)),
    Comments = factor(
      Comments,
      levels = c("success", "treatment failure", "confirmed relapse", "reinfection")
    )
  ) %>%
  drop_na(Comments)

str(plot_data)
cat("Visits present:", levels(plot_data$Visit), "\n")
cat("Outcome groups:", levels(plot_data$Comments), "\n")
```

# Define colour scheme

```{r}
#| label: colour-scheme

outcome_colors <- c(
  "success"           = "black",
  "treatment failure" = "#FF6600",
  "confirmed relapse" = "green",
  "reinfection"       = "cyan"
)
```

# Plot function

```{r}
#| label: plot-function

create_outcome_plot <- function(data, outcome, outcome_label, save_path = NULL) {

  outcome_sym <- sym(outcome)

  dat <- data %>% drop_na(all_of(outcome))

  cat(sprintf("%s: %d rows after NA removal\n", outcome, nrow(dat)))

  comparisons <- list(
    c("0", "4"), c("0", "16"), c("0", "24"),
    c("4", "16"), c("4", "24"), c("16", "24")
  )

  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = Visit, y = !!outcome_sym)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +   
    geom_jitter(
      data     = dat %>% filter(Comments == "success"),
      aes(color = Comments),
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, seed = 42),
      size     = 1.5, alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      data     = dat %>% filter(Comments != "success"),
      aes(color = Comments),
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, seed = 42),
      size     = 1.5, alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons     = comparisons,
      method          = "wilcox.test",
      p.adjust.method = "fdr",
      label           = "p.signif",
      hide.ns         = FALSE,
      vjust           = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = "Outcome") +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.02)),  
      limits = c(0, max(dat[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE) * 1.6)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = outcome_label,
      x     = "Visit (Week)",
      y     = paste0(outcome_label, " (log10, mL)")
    ) +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      axis.text        = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title       = element_text(color = "black"),
      legend.position  = "right"
    )

  print(p)

  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(save_path, paste0("Figure_4A_", outcome, ".pdf")),
      plot     = p,
      width    = 5,
      height   = 5
    )
  }

  invisible(p)
}
```

# CAVTOT

```{r}
#| label: plot-cavtot
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 6

cavtot_plot <- create_outcome_plot(
  data          = plot_data,
  outcome       = "CAVTOT",
  outcome_label = "Total cavity volume (CAVTOT)",
  save_path     = output_main
)
```

# TLG

```{r}
#| label: plot-tlg
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 6

tlg_plot <- create_outcome_plot(
  data          = plot_data,
  outcome       = "TLG",
  outcome_label = "Total lesion glycolysis volume (TLG)",
  save_path     = output_main
)
```
